description:
Load, unload, or hot-swap a behavior tree instance in the browser runtime (actions: load, unload, swap). Use load_behavior instead of manage_behaviors when executing an active behavior tree instance at runtime rather than registering or inspecting definitions.

Returns execution handle, runtime state, active node, and session/intention bindings.

action.description: Behavior loading operation: load, unload, swap

behavior_name.description: Name of the behavior tree to load

behavior_version.description: Version of behavior tree (defaults to latest)

dispatch_token.description: Cryptographically signed dispatch token issued by agent-reasoning-mcp (gate_intention)

intention.description: Optional linked intention payload matching the dispatch token

trace_id.description: Distributed trace ID for cross-server correlation

name: load_behavior
